Refining Style Since 2013

Saloo Hair by Chets is more than just a salon; it is a destination for those who value precision, luxury, and the art of personal grooming.

Master Craftsmanship

Led by Chets, our team brings over a decade of expertise in advanced hair couture and traditional grooming techniques.

Premium Products

We use only the world's finest hair and skin care brands to ensure your health and shine are never compromised.

Luxury Ambience

Step away from the city noise into our serene, high-end studio designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation.

Our Story

Located in the heart of Gandhinagar, Saloo Hair by Chets began with a simple mission: to provide world-class hair styling with a personalized touch. Every snip of the scissors and every brush stroke is executed with passion.

Whether you are looking for a classic gentleman's fade or a transformative bridal makeover, we pride ourselves on understanding the unique personality of every client who walks through our doors.
